Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out. Unfortunately, your campus does not currently have an active IXL license, so student and teacher accounts cannot be provisioned at this time.

If you believe this is an error, please contact your campus administrator to confirm licensing, and they can submit a request to the district technology team.

Helpful links:

  • IXL sign-in

Let me know if there is anything else I can help with!
